title: Looping MetaSound tone with a Pitch input
prompt: Create a looping (not one-shot) mono MetaSound Source {root}/MS_Tone with a Float input named Pitch (default 1). It plays a saw oscillator whose frequency is 110 Hz times Pitch, into the audio output, so gameplay can raise the pitch with Set Float Parameter.

tools.name: looping, Pitch float input
tools.expect: r['success'] and not r['one_shot'] and any(i['name'] == 'Pitch' and i['type'] == 'Float' for i in r['inputs'])

tools.name: Pitch -> ... -> Saw -> audio out
tools.expect: r['success'] and any(e['from'].split('.')[0] in [n['id'] for n in r['nodes'] if n['name'] == 'Pitch'] for e in r['edges']) and any('Saw' in n.get('class', '') for n in r['nodes']) and any('OutputFormat' in e['to'] or any(n['id'] == e['to'].split('.')[0] and n.get('kind') == 'Output' for n in r['nodes']) for e in r['edges'])
